subject: RE: Renewal pricing + volume step-ups — next steps and unit economics
summary: Post-demo discovery follow-up to confirm token volumes, target $/1M tokens, and propose renewal step-up pricing and blended rates for adding new routes/models. Includes internal pricing options and final proposal sent to customer.
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acmeretail.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks — recap and next steps on renewal pricing

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and the info we said we'd follow up with: 

- Confirmed volumes: current usage ~350M tokens/month (inference + embeddings), expected organic growth to ~750M tokens/month by Q4 after new personalization routes go live.
- Budget: target is to stay in the $18k–$30k / month range for inference across production routes (rough target you mentioned was ~$25k/mo).
- Primary ask: get us a renewal pricing proposal that accounts for the new routes/models (chat, long-context rerank) and shows blended unit economics and step-up tiers.

Next steps:
- I’ll send a proposed step-up pricing table and blended-rate examples for your team to review (by end of day Monday).
- Priya/Alex to confirm final expected monthly token volumes per route (chat vs embeddings vs rerank).

Attaching a short spreadsheet with the numbers I used in working examples. If helpful I can propose a 12-month renewal with quarterly step-ups and a 10% renewal credit tied to committed volume.

Thanks — talk Monday if needed.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Redwood_Pricing_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeretail.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks — recap and next steps on renewal pricing

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for sending the spreadsheet. Quick answers:
- Confirming projected split once new personalization is live: chat (45%), embeddings (30%), rerank (25%). That maps to ~750M tokens/mo total.
- The finance team set an overall target OPEX of ~$300k–$350k for the year for inference (so ~25k–29k/mo on average), but we have flexibility if unit economics above show clear ROI per route.

We’d like to see: 
1) A $/1M token unit price by tier (0–1M, 1–10M, 10–100M, 100M+) and a blended example at 750M.
2) A renewal structure that includes a 6–12 month ramp with step-ups (i.e., commit bands) and an option for an annual true-up.
3) If adding new routes/models increases committed volume, show blended pricing and a sample blended invoice.

Ping me if you want a quick internal calibration call with finance (I can loop them in).

—Alex
Director, AI Product — Acme Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal pricing — Acme (need numbers for Monday)

Rishi / Vivek —

Forwarding Alex's confirmation of volumes and budget. They're at ~750M tokens/mo expected, target ~$25k/mo. They want: tiered $/1M pricing, blended example for 750M, and a renewal structure with step-ups + true-up. Also need a sample invoice showing adding new routes/models.

Options I'm thinking to propose (feel free to revise):
A) 12-month renewal, commit 700M/month, price tiers: $120 / 1M (0–1M), $90 / 1M (1–10M), $60 / 1M (10–100M), $35 / 1M (100M+). Blended at 750M = ~$46 / 1M (~$34k/mo) — slightly above their target. Offer 12% renewal credit for commit.
B) 12-month renewal, commit 500M/month, stepped discounts: start at $70 / 1M blended and step to $40 / 1M at 12 months if usage meets 800M avg. More conservative commit (lower starting cost) aligns closer to $25k/mo target.
C) Flexible 6-month ramp with quarterly true-up and usage-based overage at $55 / 1M for excess, plus optional add-on discounted routes for embeddings (20% off standard tiers).

We should include blended examples for their route split (chat/embeddings/rerank). Can you run the actual blended math and recommend which option hits closest to $25k/mo while preserving margin? Also advise what a reasonable renewal credit % is vs. a flat discount.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal pricing — Acme (need numbers for Monday)

Marissa —

Attached quick calc (I used the same tiers but adjusted actual per-route weights). Key outputs:
- Option A (700M commit): blended unit = $58 / 1M (this assumes 45% chat @ chat mix factor x1.0, embeddings heavier cost factor x1.6, rerank x1.2). Monthly = ~$42.9k (above target). With 12% renewal credit effective blended = $51 / 1M (~$37.8k/mo).
- Option B (500M commit): starting blended = $46 / 1M (~$23k/mo) and steps to $34 / 1M at month 12 if they hit 800M avg. This hits Alex's target early and preserves upside.
- Option C (6mo ramp): starting blended = $52 / 1M with overage $55 / 1M; projected month 6 = $30k if they ramp as expected.

Recommendation: Lead with Option B as the customer-facing proposal — it aligns to their $25k/mo target, gives clear upside at year-end, and minimizes short-term margin erosion. Include an embedded clause: if new routes add >15% of total tokens, automatically move to blended re-rate and apply a one-time onboarding credit of 5% for the added-route volume.

Notes: 1) We should model blended invoice examples for +/− 20% volume variance. 2) For adding routes/models, recommend we price embeddings at a 15–20% premium to base generation tiers unless they commit additional volume.

I'll attach the calc sheet.

—Rishi
Director, Revenue Strategy | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Acme_blended_calcs.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acmeretail.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal proposal: step-up pricing + blended examples (Acme Retail)

Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the patience — attached is a concise renewal proposal and a worked example for 750M tokens/mo using your route split. Highlights: 
- We recommend Option B as the recommended path: 12-month renewal, 500M/month committed starting month 1 with quarterly step-ups.
- Starting blended rate (month 1): $46 / 1M → estimated month 1 invoice ~$23K. If usage ramps to 800M avg we step to blended $34 / 1M by month 12.
- Add-on routes/models (embeddings, rerank): priced at a 15% premium to base until new committed volume is added. If adding routes increases total committed volume >15%, we recalc a blended rate and apply a one-time 5% onboarding credit on that added volume.
- True-up: annual with quarterly checkpoints. Overage: $55 / 1M.

Attached: Redwood_Pricing_v3.xlsx (detail) and a draft SOW (Renewal_SOW_Acme_2026.pdf). If this looks good I can turn it into a DocuSign and route to legal.

Would you like a short 30-min call to walk through the blended invoice example with finance?

Best,
Marissa
[Attachment: Renewal_SOW_Acme_2026.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acmeretail.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: step-up pricing + blended examples (Acme Retail)

Marissa —

Appreciate the thoroughness. This aligns with our internal targets. Two quick asks before we loop legal: 
1) Can you show the blended invoice with +20% and -20% volume scenarios?
2) We prefer a 60-day review window on the first quarter to adjust step-ups if variability is higher than expected.

If you can send that by Friday we’ll aim to get legal and finance in the loop the following week.

Thanks — Priya
Prod Finance Manager — Acme Retail
